fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-05-16, around 23:45, the complainant reported suspicious activity near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony, where a person was allegedly handing over packets to visitors at night, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-05-16. The online submission was made by Padmini Bai (9000000447). The complainant noted the registration number TN-33-XX-1072 of a yellow car. Vasanth Mani (9000000382), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Balaji Karuppasamy, using the number 9000000407. A second person, Jagan Raman (9000000369), was also mentioned as possibly present. A witness, Abirami Sekar, reachable on 9000000186, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage, a witness statement and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: CCTV footage; Witness statement; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Repeated suspicious exchanges allegedly observed near a public place.
